motion.name: computation-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal the successfully initialized live graph over its deterministic SVG fallback; global reduced-motion CSS suppresses the transition. The background responds to mouse movement, mouse drag and click or tap, with no caption, instructions or action buttons. Continuous animation follows the operating-system reduced-motion preference directly and pauses offscreen or in hidden tabs. Signals remain static under reduced motion.

motion.name: home-scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Scroll-follow smoothing for the title separation and live graph camera at every width. At viewport heights of at least 540px, Home pins for 1.85 viewport heights at widths of at least 900px and 1.15 below, with a bridge reveal and progress track. Heights of 540–679px use compact typography and bridge actions. Below 540px the title and camera scrub over 0.85 viewport heights while the bridge remains readable in normal flow. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: media-scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Robotics and Music image-aperture reveals and scale easing at every width. Fitting compositions hold for 0.68 and 0.52 viewport heights respectively. Below 1024px, travel is 65% of those distances and a fitting photograph can pin separately when the stacked composition is too tall; oversized media remains unpinned. Top clearance is 86px below 768px, 96px from 768px through 1023px and 112px at 1024px and above, with 28px of bottom clearance. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: resume-scroll-progress
motion.purpose: Section rules extend and headings shift toward the accent at every width as the document scrolls, without pinning the resume. Disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Fixed route navigation with centered desktop links and an always-visible Glass switch at the right, beside the menu target below 768px. The 44px switch uses role=switch, aria-checked and the accessible name Liquid glass navigation. Glass defaults on; the browser saves the choice across routes and reloads, with an in-memory fallback when storage is unavailable. Off uses an opaque #0b111c surface, a hairline border and 12px corners with no backdrop effect, shadow or sheen. Both states retain the same navigation and content. Glass-on navigation has a layered highlight over a 0.24-opacity black tint, inset highlights and a diffuse shadow. Supporting engines use a PNG normal map derived from the bar dimensions and rounded corners with a 16px rim, regenerated only on resize while enabled; the initial SVG map remains the fallback. Edge displacement is -20, warp noise 24, optical blur 0.2px, saturation 155%, contrast 1.04 and brightness 1.08, with unchanged fine grain. WebKit/Gecko retain 14px frosted blur. The simplified snippet illustrates glass, solid and switch styles without the SVG filter, map generator or preference wiring.

narrative.overview:
Black grounds, ice-white lettering, blue controls and smoked refracting glass connect Home, Projects, Music and Resume. Oversized condensed typography establishes identity; real project images, performance photographs and ruled records carry the evidence. The interface is spacious around introductions and denser around project details, repertoire and resume entries.

Music shares the blue-and-black palette and condensed typography. The existing JG identity and portfolio media remain binding assets under `PRODUCT.md`. Original project screenshots and factual photographs retain their source colors without redefining the interface palette. The Computer Science highlight uses the same flat, ruled row as the Robotics and Music highlights; its former blue background was removed at the user’s request.

This record describes the current implemented CSS and components. The user-authorized cinematic Home opening supersedes layout A’s first viewport. Earlier layout A captures and the forced hero/responsive gates in `.impeccable/build/state.json` remain historical records of that earlier composition, including its original-content exceptions and typography drift. They are not reference captures or approval for the current title card; this document is not a shipping verdict.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display typography with readable sans-serif evidence text.
Dark tonal surfaces, thin rules and restrained blue interaction states.
Refracting navigation and a scroll-held title card over a live computation network.
Original project media and complete content across all four routes.
dos: Do preserve the existing identity, media, content and accomplishments required by PRODUCT.md.
Do use the condensed hierarchy and retain comfortable reading measures for evidence text.
Do use direct sentence-case headings, factual descriptions and action labels that state their destination or outcome.
Do keep music in the shared blue-and-black palette.
Do preserve real background refraction, static fallbacks, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do allow responsive content to flow rather than clipping text to the desktop composition.
donts: Don't reintroduce the obsolete old green interface or light paper music theme.
Don't recolor original portfolio media to force palette uniformity.
Don't present the interactive graph as real performance data or a measured system.
Don't promote leftover uppercase supporting labels into a required eyebrow or kicker system.
Don't describe recorded review exceptions as clean pixel matches or shipping approval.
